note: Parked on 2026-11-26 when the Cookie Pantry became a simple start with no boss. Not loaded by the game. Kept so Baron Crumblewick can return in a later location or event (his portrait stays in src/client/public/art/imps/).

flavour.tagline: Lord of the larder, by his own decree.
flavour.description: Scrinch's lieutenant in the Pantry, a pompous imp in a spring-lined coat. Clockwork outwits him; starlight can't dazzle him.
flavour.backstory: Baron Crumblewick declared himself ruler of the Pantry and wears a cookie crumb crown to prove it. He lines his coat with springs stolen from the mixers so he can bounce out of danger. He laughs at starlight, but a clockwork trap ticking faster than his springs is his one real fear.
flavour.rumour: Someone has been holding court on the top shelf, wearing a crown of crumbs.
